description: Pi-hole, version 6 and later, through its API: the names are its local DNS records, one for each address. Pi-hole answers their reverse names too, and gives them the TTL of its own local records. A record you wrote with several names on its line is left as it is.

address.description: The address of its web interface, as http://192.168.1.2.

tls_fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the server's certificate, as 64 hex digits, colons allowed, for when it can't be verified otherwise. Without it, the certificate must be valid.

password.description: The password of the web interface, or an application password, which two-factor authentication requires. Leave it out where Pi-hole has no password.

zone.description: The domain the names are under, as lan.example.com. Pi-hole has no zones: it is only what a name written alone, as nas, is completed with.
